Taiwanese actor Chen Yifei stands against a dark background in a tailored black suit, striped shirt, and black tie. With a focused gaze and neatly styled hair, he adjusts his cuff, projecting a polished and professional image in this studio portrait.

Born on January 29, 1979 in Taipei, Chen graduated from the University of California, Irvine before launching his acting career in 2002. David Chen Portrait

David Chen, a Taiwanese actor born in Taipei in 1979, appears in a formal studio portrait wearing a dark suit, striped shirt, and tie. His neatly styled hair and subtle earring complement his composed expression, reflecting his professional image.

With a career spanning one feature film and twelve television series, Chen is best known for roles in The Brightest Star in the Sky, Love is Not Blind, and 你好乔安. This portrait captures the polished presence of an established actor in the entertainment industry.
